motivation: Original source-reconstructed SO3 history has no advantage against matched known-coordinate baseline. New, distinct question: minimal explicit acknowledgment bits necessary for guaranteeing correct controller anchor restoration when observation is quantized and receipt sender knows executed binary ACK history.
fundamental_prior_art: Orlitsky–Roche zero-error functional computation with receiver side information and characteristic/confusability graph; this is NOT a first new theorem or novel graph coloring algorithm.
controller_model: Latent executed action history h is H binary acknowledgements. Actual controller anchor = sum_i bit_i*step_i where step_i is sampled from a fixed finite list independently per seed and morphology. Visible endpoint is controller anchor plus bounded sensor noise quantized by floor((position+noise)/resolution). Safe next correction requires the exact anchor (distinct history with equal anchor is same safe action).
seed_formula: Python Random(20261013 + seed*19 + H*7 + morphology_index*101) choices(with_replacement), use Decimal integer scaled by 20 to avoid floating graph ambiguity
sensor_support: For each history observation z, enumerate all integer bins floor((anchor+noise)/quantization) possible for noise in closed [-epsilon,+epsilon] using integer arithmetic; include exact interval endpoints
conflict_graph: An edge connects two ACK histories precisely if possible quantized observations intersect AND required exact controller anchor differs
codec: Deterministic exact branch-and-bound DSATUR chromatic coloring, one fixed-length bit string per hidden ACK history, independent of observation; decoder uses tag + observation to recover required anchor
baselines: no receipt: optimal MAP anchor given quantized observation, assuming uniform hidden histories and uniform finite observation bins
principal_metrics: minimal receipt bits = ceil(log2 chromatic_number) under this exact model
MAP no-receipt decision correctness over explicitly enumerated history-observation tuples
DSATUR exact-coloring optimality verified by independent brute assignment for all H=3 cases
predeclared_research_gate: at least 25% receipt-bit saving in at least half of 288 environment cases (2 morphologies x 2 H x 12 seeds x 3 resolutions x 2 sensor radii); retain all zero-gain cases; zero safety decoding errors; no performance claim outside finite quantized model
scientific_limits: No native PhysX or hardware rollout in this phase; do not claim task-success improvement
Encoder is assumed to know actual ACK execution history by trusted telemetry; without it no receipt can be generated
The graph-coloring theorem and zero-error side-information concept are prior art; novelty is at most systems-specific formulation/integration
Integer sensor support is idealized and bounded-noise; real unbounded noise invalidates zero-error guarantee
This is an informational/communication cost study, not a novel posterior algorithm or demonstration beating optimal Bayesian policy given the same information
external_status: Fork-only theoretical simulator until native controller instrumentation and outside maintainer review
